headline: Record order inflows drive healthy growth; margin recovery remains key

highlights: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research ABB India (ABB ) CMP: ₹6935 Target ₹ 8275 (19%) Target Period: 12 months November 17, 2026 Record order inflows drive healthy growth; margin recovery remains key … About the stock : ABB is a technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future.
Q 3C Y2 6 performance : ABB India reported Q3CY26 revenue of ₹3,738 crore, up 19.4% YoY and 5.0% QoQ.
EBITDA grew 13.7% YoY to ₹552 crore, while EBITDA margin contracted 75 bps YoY to 14.8%.
Gross margin declined 79 bps YoY to 40.9%, as COGS increased 21.0% YoY to ₹2,211 crore, outpacing revenue growth.

Around 40% of the backlog comprises large orders executed over multiple quarters, while the balance is generally executable over 4–5 quarters.
Rating and Target Price : We expect revenues and PAT to grow at CAGR of 16% and 12% over CY25-CY28E.
